schema_clarification.exact_text: Exact title/identifier identity, with normalization at matching. Preserve supplied punctuation and permitted identifier hyphens in the authored operand.
schema_clarification.provenance: Coordinator supplied field-semantics-only clarification before authoring/freeze; no predictions, prior labels, source, or results supplied.

provenance.method: Each of 68 supplied records was independently authored from query semantics, scoped capabilities/vocabulary, the supplied normative contract, and field-semantics-only clarification. field_policy: Only expected_fields are proposed direct field values. Omission is not a command to clear a field. Null is explicit absence. Semantic predicates and eligibility examples specify meaning and strict rating boundaries. AI_REVIEWED is provenance, not certainty for unresolved projections.
query_hash_definition: SHA-256 of exact query string encoded UTF-8 without trimming/normalization

field_semantics.title_text: Single literal Title/Author OR predicate: the normalized operand must occur in title OR author; it is not necessarily an inferred title entity.
field_semantics.exact_text: Exact title/identifier identity, with normalization at matching. Preserve supplied punctuation and permitted identifier hyphens in the authored operand.
field_semantics.provenance: Coordinator supplied field-semantics-only clarification before authoring/freeze; no predictions, prior labels, source, or results supplied.

rating_boundary_policy: rating_min records the numeric threshold. Above is strictly greater; semantic_predicates and rating_min_inclusive=false specify the required boundary independently of unspecified DTO strictness encoding.
eligibility_policy: Examples refer to authored semantic constraints and assume ordinary access/catalogue eligibility. Soft topic evidence supports relevance but is not converted to a hard canonical gate. Null eligible explicitly means hard classification cannot be established from supplied information.
versioning_policy: This is a new independently authored C4 artifact. It does not claim that any unseen historical assertion or earlier label has been compared, disproved, or automatically replaced. The frozen independent contracts must precede such comparison.

rules.CATEGORY_NEGATIVE: A bare canonical category excluded by not, but not, excluding, without, or except contributes its scoped canonical exclusion predicate. It does not additionally prohibit its wording in title, author, or description.
rules.TOPIC_NEGATIVE: Not about explicitly addresses content/topic. Under the supplied text-negative predicate contract it contributes a literal text exclusion, not an independently inferred canonical category exclusion.
rules.NO_DOUBLE_NEGATIVE_INFERENCE: Do not infer both canonical subject and literal text prohibition from one negative phrase without separate evidence for both predicates.
rules.NOT_ONLY: Not only is additive/nonexclusive, not a prohibition. It does not by itself justify either excluding Romance or making Romance a mandatory hard gate for every result.
rules.HYPHENATED_LEXEME: Non-fiction is a lexical category phrase; non- is not a standalone canonical subject-exclude operator. Do not split off Fiction as a negative or invent an unavailable canonical label.
rules.CANONICAL_CONFLICT: Requiring and excluding the same canonical subject is contradictory until an explicit choice edits that subject predicate.
rules.CANONICAL_CONFLICT_CHOICE: Selecting Exclude Romance resolves the canonical conflict by removing Romance from required subjects and retaining it in excluded subjects. It does not add a broad literal romance text ban.
rules.REFINEMENT_PRESERVATION: An explicit negative/rating refinement preserves the unrelated accepted machine-learning topic from the prior query.
rules.CHIP_ITEM_PRESERVATION: Removing the Fiction include chip and Romance exclude chip removes only those items; Mystery, excluded Biography, and the rating threshold survive, with or without a session.
rules.LITERAL_MODE: TITLE_AUTHOR carries the complete supplied raw query in title_text, the single title OR author operand. It does not activate SMART author extraction or discard request words, punctuation, or spacing.
rules.SMART_IDENTITY: Complete ISBN identity syntax is accepted in SMART and can execute even when no catalog record exists. Retain the raw identifier spelling in exact_text; matching may normalize permitted hyphens.
rules.FREE_PREFIX_NOT_TITLE: Free text before by AUTHOR is not sufficient title evidence. Keep the explicit author predicate and preserve the prefix as soft text; do not create title_text or exact title identity without explicit title syntax/evidence.
rules.PARTIAL_AUTHORING: Only expected_fields are direct authored field values. Omitted fields remain untouched; unresolved projections are visible. Synthetic eligibility examples express semantic predicates independently of application behavior.
